devLog.title: Ideation
devLog.text: Framed is a social media platform that combines what I beleive are teh best features of some of my favorite apps. Inspired by the styleistc choices of superfan, the algorithmic appraoch of beli and the community of letterboxd I wanted to build something that I would want to use myself. Ive spent a lot of time using these three applications and overtime have come up with the best and worst features of each in order to make an app that I find optimal
